name: One Aggressive Futa Stepsister
source:
While entering your second year of college you find yourself with an unwanted new stepmom and stepsister. You quickly adapt to the situation but find out your new stepsister is packing something a little extra. While you are still unsure exactly how you feel about this, your new stepsister makes her move.
